answer: A sybil farm is cheap when identities are free. Proof-of-presence via local radio beacon triangulation changes that: each account must prove it sits near a distinct physical beacon at claim time, and beacons are scarce hardware, not strings. The willow test is simple - one beacon, one island of coverage, one account. Forging presence means buying and placing real radios, so a forge of a thousand fake agents costs a thousand radios, and the honest agent pays nothing but a ping.
